d: Can Iran turn American and Israeli weapons against their own creators? Tehran claims it has captured enemy military equipment and is now examining and reverse-engineering the technology. The objective is to unlock the secrets behind advanced weapons and use those lessons to strengthen Iran's own military capabilities. As Donald Trump signals that the war is nearing an end, Iran is showcasing underground missile cities, drone capabilities and what it describes as major battlefield achievements. But how much of this is genuine military progress, and how much is strategic messaging?…
